summary: Ctormy Taylor, 23, went missing after the boat he was in with two female friends capsized on the Colorado River in Grand Junction near the 5th Street bridge on Monday; the two women self-rescued by swimming to a nearby island. Search and rescue crews searched Monday and Tuesday; the Mesa County Sheriff's Office concluded he was believed dead and shifted to a recovery mission.
location: Colorado River near the 5th Street bridge, Grand Junction
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; search and rescue crews
notes: Outcome = fatality (presumed; never located in source — MCSO shifted to recovery mission; cf. ids 1160/2693); 2014-05-26 Monday-verified.
